name: Date or Time or Period
sourceRefs: PyX12 (azoner/pyx12) 837.5010.X222.A1.xml — new segment for Phase 2, reused for every one of 837P/837I's ~25 distinct date roles (Onset of Illness, Initial Treatment, Service Date, etc.) purely via DTP01's own qualifier value, matching this project's own established 'one shared segment, many roles distinguished only by a qualifier field' pattern already proven for REF/AMT/QTY. DTP03 is modeled AN rather than DT: DTP02 (format qualifier) can be 'D8' (single CCYYMMDD date) OR 'RD8' (a CCYYMMDD-CCYYMMDD RANGE, e.g. for Date - Assumed and Relinquished Care Dates) — a strict DT type would wrongly reject every legitimate RD8 range value.
